note: acquisition des actifs de domaines de Google (noms de domaine dont Google était registraire ou revendeur), réalisée le 7 septembre 2023 pour un montant total payé de 180 721 milliers de dollars ; acquisition d'actifs, sans famille
quote: On September 7, 2023, the Company closed an asset purchase agreement with Google LLC ("Google") to acquire, among other things, Google's domain assets, including all domain names for which Google was the registrar or reseller, for a total amount paid of $180,721 (the "Google Domains Asset Acquisition").
